label: Interval Tasks
summary: Recurring unattended execution of an existing endpoint, stored in ofapi_intervaltask. A task says when to call the endpoint, with what payload and with whose credentials; it never contains code of its own.

scheduler_delay_ms.strategy: sleep until the nearest next_run; API writes wake the worker immediately

max_backoff_seconds_per_task.description: Ceiling of the exponential backoff for this task. Null uses the global max_backoff_seconds.

backoff_enabled.description: When false, the task keeps its normal interval on failure instead of doubling it. Intended for monitoring tasks.

suspension.description: When failed_attempts reaches max_failed_attempts the scheduler suspends the task by setting disabled_by = 'system' and disabled_reason, WITHOUT flipping enabled (that is the user's intent). Eligibility requires enabled = true and disabled_by IS NULL. reset_interval_task_attempts, or an upsert with enabled: true, clears both and lets it run again.

task_group.description: Tasks sharing exclusive_group never run at the same time, even with different idtask. When the group is busy, skip leaves the task for its next natural occurrence and wait reschedules next_run to now + 30 s. The check only considers group members that are running with an unexpired locked_until.

endpoint.description: When ofapi_endpoint.exclusive is true, every caller serializes through a database lease. A second concurrent call answers 409 ENDPOINT_LOCKED. Endpoints without exclusive never reach the lock module.
